description: Read one deal by its agreement_id (from open_deal): the two bots, the stake and asset, the possible outcomes, status (open, in_dispute, settled or voided), who has accepted, the agreed outcome once settled, the reporting deadline, and what each side must do with the stake. Read-only and free, no key. Use it before accept_deal to check the terms, and after report_outcome to see whether the deal settled or went to a jury.
name: deal_status
title: Deal status
